detail.longDescription: How do a few basic connections give rise to decision-making, memory, and thought? Aatish Bhatia’s interactive essay "Let’s Build a Brain" shows how intelligence emerges from the ground up – starting with simple logic gates and evolving into complex neural behaviors. Seeing the wiring in action makes computational neuroscience click in an entirely new way. Explore the visual explainer: https:// aatishb.com/myriad/lets-build- a-brain/ # Neuroscience # AI # ComplexSystems # MachineLearning
